reason: Joining is free, so I might look at it, but I do not want to quote blind against my competitors on price, and I do not trust a platform that takes 10% off every job when my customers could simply take my number and go direct next time.
objection: If the customer finds me through the app, what stops them from calling me directly after the first job and skipping the 10%?
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the app sends paying jobs in my area that I could not get on my own, with customers who stay on the platform.
